name: Shrubi Restaurant Manager
author: hadiweslati

sections.description:
Shrubi Restaurant Manager helps restaurant owners embed their Shrubi booking pages into their WordPress site with ease. It allows you to manage your restaurant URLs, create an account, and preview the embedded experience — all from your WordPress dashboard.

The plugin also adds a custom Gutenberg block, making it simple to drop your Shrubi page into any post or page. Designed for ease of use, even for non-technical users.

Features:
– Add or remove Shrubi restaurant URLs from the admin screen
– Create a new Shrubi account directly from WordPress
– Use a custom block to embed booking pages
– Fully responsive iframe for a clean mobile experience
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/shrubi directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the Shrubi menu in your WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Paste your Shrubi booking URL or create a new account.
  5. Use the “Shrubi” block in the Gutenberg editor to embed your restaurant booking page.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Shrubi account to use this plugin?

Yes. You can either paste your existing Shrubi booking URL or create an account directly from the admin panel.

Can I embed more than one restaurant?

Yes, you can add and manage multiple Shrubi URLs and remove them as needed.

Is this plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes, the embedded iframe scales well on all devices.
